sourceText: In the proofbound repo, `lattice story_advance --phase=INIT_CHECK` fails to bounce a story that is at PLAN with an active worktree, making it impossible to fix a frozen checklist title/context that a PLAN scope review legitimately flags. Root cause verified in worktree.ts:910 (storyRel resolved relative to the resolved repo root gains a .worktrees/<id>/ prefix when run from inside the worktree, so the branch-content guard false-fails). Fix direction: resolve storyRel/worktree path against the same root the branch tree is rooted at, or detect the branch already contains the canonical metadata and reuse the existing worktree. Add a smoke that bounces a PLAN-phase worktree'd story back to INIT_CHECK, edits a title, re-runs INIT review, and re-advances, proving the round-trip works without manual git surgery or checklist hand-edits.
normalizedOutcome: A PLAN-phase worktree'd story whose frozen checklist title a scope review flagged can be reopened (to INIT, the only phase where title/context is editable), have its title edited, re-run INIT review, and re-advance INIT_CHECK->PLAN, entirely from inside the existing worktree, with no git surgery and no hand-edited checklist.json. A permanent round-trip smoke proves it RED before the fix and GREEN after.
acceptanceClaim: Running lattice story_advance phase=INIT with a reason from a PLAN worktree reopens the story to INIT; the re-advance INIT->INIT_CHECK reuses the existing worktree instead of false-failing on a .worktrees/<id>/-prefixed branch path; the title-freeze guidance names the reopen-to-INIT path; and the round-trip smoke passes GREEN after the fix and fails RED before it.
